raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Refs Ascend/sglang#1209.

The GLM-5.1 cookbook has no Ascend NPU option, although the [Ascend NPU GLM-5.1 best practice](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/best-practices/glm_5_1) documents measured multi-node recipes. This PR adds the two scenarios the task asks for, so you can pick a deployment on **Atlas 800I A3** and get the command for it:

- **PD Mixed on 2 × A3** (32 dies, one server across two nodes)
- **1P1D PD disaggregation on 4 × A3** (64 dies, each role is a two-node server)

## Modifications

### Page layout

The GPU generator on this page is still the legacy `glm-51-deployment.jsx`. Instead of extending that component, the Ascend section renders the shared `Deployment` engine with an A3-only config (`configs/zai-org/glm-5.1-ascend.jsx`), the same approach as #38800 (Qwen3-Next). The GPU widget and its commands are untouched.

This keeps the diff to data plus one MDX section. The A3 config uses the same format as a config-driven page, so if this page is ever moved onto the shared template, the three cells drop straight into its config and the second widget goes away.

### Recipes

| Deployment | Source (Ascend best practice) | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| PD Mixed | `W4A8 16P IN3K5 OUT1K5 50ms` | `--tp-size 32 --dp-size 16`, DeepEP auto, NEXTN 3-1-4 |
| PD Disagg · Prefill | `W4A8 1P1D 32P IN16K OUT1K 50ms` | `--tp-size 32`, interleave prefill CP across all 32 ranks, DeepEP normal, graph capture off |
| PD Disagg · Decode | same | `--tp-size 32 --dp-size 32 --ep-size 32`, DeepEP low_latency, NEXTN 3-1-4 |

- Every cell sets `nnodes: 2`, so the engine injects `--nnodes 2 --node-rank --dist-init-addr`. The selector id is `pdMode`, so the engine gives the roles their own serving ports (prefill 30000, decode 30100). The router command is in the page text.
- Checkpoint: `Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a8` (msModelSlim W4A8, 420 GB; `--quantization modelslim`). Its `quant_model_description.json` stores the MTP layer (layer 78) as FLOAT, so the recipes pass `--speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant`.
- `dockerImages.a3` is `quay.io/ascend/sglang:v0.5.22-cann9.1.0-a3`. v0.5.22 (2026-10-13) is the first release carrying both features these recipes need — NPU prefill CP (#39427) and `--attn-dp-size` (#41818) — and all three generated commands resolve against that release's `server_args` as well as against `main`. The rolling `main-cann9.1.0-a3` tag the Ascend docs use works too, but it moves.

### Differences from the best-practice scripts

The recipes are transcribed as written, including the prefill role's context parallelism (`--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy zigzag --attn-cp-size 8`), which NPU supports again after #39427. The remaining changes are spelling updates that current `main` requires:

- Recipes follow the 2026-10-15 revision of the best practice (#44432, the CANN 9.1.0 update), and `dockerImages.a3` pins that page's CANN 9.1.0 line to the `v0.5.22` release image.
- `--dp-size N --enable-dp-attention` → `--attn-dp-size N` (deprecated in #41818), `--disable-cuda-graph` → `--cuda-graph-backend-{decode,prefill} disabled`, `--moe-dense-tp` → `--moe-dense-tp-size`.
- `SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2` is dropped (removed on `main`, only logs a warning) and so is `SGLANG_SPEC_ENABLE_OVERLAP_REFLOW` (nothing reads it). `--served-model-name glm-5` is dropped so the cURL example's model name matches.
- The best practice's 64k and 128k 1P1D entries drive prefill CP through `--enable-nsa-prefill-context-parallel` / `--nsa-prefill-cp-mode`, which #38293 removed; this PR ships the 16k entry, whose `--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy zigzag` form is the supported one. (The NPU CI cases under `test/registered/npu/*/glm5_1/` still carry the removed flags and the pre-#39427 skip reason, so they stay disabled — worth a follow-up by the NPU CI owners.)

All three cells are marked `verificationStatus: "in-progress"`, like the Kimi-K3 A3 cell in #35508.

### Notes against the cookbook review checklist

- **Parsers are baked into the cells.** The checklist keeps `--reasoning-parser` / `--tool-call-parser` in the Playground, but this page has no Playground (the GPU half is still the legacy generator), so a parser left out of the cell is a parser the reader never gets. The merged Kimi-K3 A3 cells do the same, and the legacy GPU generator on this page emits both parsers by default. Both ids are registered on `main` (`glm45`, `glm47`).
- **No `playgroundFeatures` and `showPlaygroundLink: false`**, same as #38800: this widget only renders the deployment matrix.
- **`matchDims` instead of the legacy five dimensions** (`quant` x `pdMode`, with `nnodes` on the cell), following `kimi-k3.jsx`. Each PD role needs `--nnodes 2`, which a `nodes` dimension cannot express.
- **The router listens on 30000**, the port the cookbook convention asks for. The engine assigns the roles 30000 (prefill) and 30100 (decode), so the page notes that the router needs a node other than the prefill head, or a free port there.

## Accuracy Tests

**Not measured in this PR.** The recipes are transcribed from the Ascend GLM-5.1 best practice, which publishes its own measurements; this PR does not re-run them. A3 full nodes (2 x and 4 x, 16 dies each) were not available to me — the HiDevLab allocation I can claim is a single 8-card 910B4 node (32 GiB/die, 256 GB total), and the W4A8 checkpoint alone is 391 GB.

All three cells therefore ship as `verificationStatus: "in-progress"`, the same state the merged Kimi-K3 A3 cell (#35508) has, and the page says so in its Verification status note. Once someone runs them on A3, the numbers go into a `glm-5.1-ascend-benchmarks.jsx` and the cells flip to verified. I have a runbook with the exact commands the page emits, pass criteria and the logs to collect, and I'm happy to hand it over or fill in the results.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Not measured in this PR**, same reason. The best-practice entries each table row links to carry the published TPOT target of 50 ms for both workloads (3.5k+1.5k and 16k+1k), which is what a verification run should compare against.

## Verification done without hardware

- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`: OK
- `mint validate` and `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` (mint 4.2.559, same as CI): both pass.
- Server-args dry run on CPU: each generated command goes through `prepare_server_args()` **and** `ServerArgs.resolve_once()` (the full resolution and validation pipeline) with the platform overridden to NPU. All three exit 0 with no warnings, and the prefill role keeps `enable_prefill_cp=True`, `cp_strategy=zigzag`, `attn_cp_size=8` after resolution.
- Browser walk-through with `mint dev` and headless Chrome: all three deployments render Python and Docker commands identical to the cells, the GPU generator is unchanged, and the page has no console errors.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to pre-commit (codespell, whitespace).
- [ ] Add unit tests — N/A (docs/config only; covered by `check_cookbook_configs.mjs`).
- [x] Update documentation.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results — pending hardware (see above).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

files.patch: @@ -1,7 +1,7 @@ --- title: GLM-5.1 metatags: - description: "Deploy GLM-5.1 with SGLang on NVIDIA H100/H200/B300/GB300 and AMD MI300X/MI325X/MI355X." + description: "Deploy GLM-5.1 with SGLang on NVIDIA H100/H200/B300/GB300, AMD MI300X/MI325X/MI355X, and Ascend Atlas 800I A3 NPUs." --- ## 1. Model Introduction @@ -24,17 +24,59 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware ### 3.1 Basic Configuration -**Interactive Command Generator**: Use the configuration selector below to automatically generate the appropriate deployment command for your hardware platform, quantization method, and capabilities. SGLang supports serving GLM-5.1 on NVIDIA H100, H200, B300, GB300, and AMD MI300X/MI325X/MI355X GPUs. +**Interactive Command Generator**: Use the configuration selector below to automatically generate the appropriate deployment command for your hardware platform, quantization method, and capabilities. SGLang supports serving GLM-5.1 on NVIDIA H100, H200, B300, GB300, and AMD MI300X/MI325X/MI355X GPUs. For Ascend Atlas 800I A3 NPUs, see [Ascend NPU Deployment](#ascend-npu-deployment) below. import { GLM51Deployment } from '/src/snippets/autoregressive/glm-51-deployment.jsx' +import { Deployment } from '/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx' +import { config as ascendConfig } from '/src/snippets/configs/zai-org/glm-5.1-ascend.jsx' All recipes here run the DSA indexer top-k on the default `--dsa-topk-backend sgl-kernel`. Other top-k backend choices have not been fully validated on GLM-5.1. -### 3.2 Configuration Tips + + +### 3.2 Ascend NPU Deployment + +GLM-5.1 also runs on **Atlas 800I A3** with the msModelSlim W4A8 checkpoint. One A3 node is 8 cards × 2 dies = 16 devices, and every recipe below spans two nodes per server, so each command runs `--tp-size 32` with `--nnodes 2`: + +| Deployment | Hardware | What it starts | Best-practice entry | +| --- | --- | --- | --- | +| **PD Mixed** | 2 × A3 (32 dies) | one server that both prefills and decodes | [W4A8 16P 3.5k+1.5k, TPOT 50 ms](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/best-practices/glm_5_1#glm-5-1-w4a8-16p-in3k5-out1k5-50ms) | +| **PD Disagg · Prefill** + **PD Disagg · Decode** | 4 × A3 (64 dies) | a 1P1D pair — one two-node server per role — fronted by a router | [W4A8 1P1D 32P 16k+1k, TPOT 50 ms](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/best-practices/glm_5_1#glm-5-1-w4a8-1p1d-32p-in16k-out1k-50ms) | + + + +- **Environment.** Use the CANN image shown in the Docker tab, or follow the [Ascend NPU quickstart](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/getting-started/quick_start) / [installation guide](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/getting-started/installation). Inside the container, source CANN first: `source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh` and `source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh`. +- **Weights.** The recipes serve [`Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a8`](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a8) (420 GB). The cells set `SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE=1` so `--model-path` resolves against ModelScope; for a multi-node deployment, download the weights once to shared storage and point `--model-path` at that directory instead. Quantization covers the main model only — the MTP (nextn) layer stays BF16, which is why the recipes pass `--speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant`. +- **Prepare every host.** The recipes assume the CPU governor and kernel scheduler settings from the Ascend best practice: + + ```bash Command + echo performance | tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor + sysctl -w vm.swappiness=0 + sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0 + sysctl -w kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns=50000 + ``` + +- **Wire up the nodes.** Set `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` and `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME` to the interface that carries each node's own IP. Each two-node server has its own head node: run the command on both of its nodes with `--node-rank 0` on the head and `1` on the other, and point `--dist-init-addr` at that server's head. In PD disaggregation, all four nodes share one `ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL` that points at the prefill head node — it is the rendezvous for the KV transfer. Start the prefill role first, then the decode role. +- **Front the PD roles with a router.** Once both roles are up, start the router and send requests to its port, `30000`. Only each role's head node serves HTTP, so run the router on a node that is not the prefill head — otherwise give it a free port instead, since the prefill role already listens on `30000` there: + + ```bash Command + python3 -m sglang_router.launch_router \ + --pd-disaggregation \ + --policy round_robin \ + --prefill http://:30000 8998 \ + --decode http://:30100 \ + --host 0.0.0.0 \ + --port 30000 + ``` + +- **Differences from the Ascend best practice.** The recipes follow the best-practice scripts, including the prefill role's context parallelism (`--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave --attn-cp-size 32`), which spans all 32 prefill ranks and therefore runs without attention DP. Flags whose spelling the scripts predate are replaced by their current equivalents: `--attn-dp-size` for `--dp-size N --enable-dp-attention`, `--cuda-graph-backend-{decode,prefill} disabled` for `--disable-cuda-graph`, and `--moe-dense-tp-size` for `--moe-dense-tp`. Three things the scripts set are left out: `SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2` and `SGLANG_SPEC_ENABLE_OVERLAP_REFLOW`, which current SGLang no longer reads, and `--served-model-name glm-5`, so that requests use the checkpoint name the cURL example shows. +- **Verification status.** These recipes are transcribed from the best-practice entries linked above and have **not been run on A3 hardware for this page**, so both deployments are marked **In progress** and the benchmark card carries no numbers. For measured configurations, tuning and accuracy methods, see the [GLM-5.1 Ascend best practice](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/best-practices/glm_5_1), [parameter tuning](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/optimization/parameter_tuning) and [accuracy evaluation](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/evaluation/accuracy_evaluation); for startup failures, the [Ascend NPU FAQ](/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/faq). + +### 3.3 Configuration Tips - Speculative decoding (MTP) can significantly reduce latency for interactive use cases. - **DP Attention**: Enables data parallel attention for higher throughput under high concurrency. Note that DP attention trades off low-concurrency latency for high-concurrency throughput — disable it if your workload is latency-sensitive with few concurrent requests.

+// Cells are denormalized: no `--nnodes`/`--node-rank`/`--dist-init-addr`/`--host`/`--port` literals — engine injects them.
+//
+// Ascend NPU (Atlas 800I A3) deployments for GLM-5.1. The GPU recipes on the
+// same page still come from the legacy generator (glm-51-deployment.jsx); this
+// config only carries the A3 cells, so it can fold into a config-driven
+// GLM-5.1 page as-is. Recipes are transcribed from the Ascend GLM-5.1 best
+// practice (/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/model-deployment/best-practices/glm_5_1):
+//   PD Mixed          -> "W4A8 16P IN3K5 OUT1K5 50ms" (2 A3 nodes, 32 dies).
+//   Prefill / Decode  -> "W4A8 1P1D 32P IN16K OUT1K 50ms" (4 A3 nodes, 2 per role).
+// Transcribed from the 2026-10-15 revision of that page (CANN 9.1.0 update, #44432).
+// Deviations from the best-practice scripts, all forced by current main:
+//   - --disable-cuda-graph -> --cuda-graph-backend-{decode,prefill} disabled,
+//     --moe-dense-tp -> --moe-dense-tp-size (deprecated / abbreviated spellings).
+//   - SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2 and SGLANG_SPEC_ENABLE_OVERLAP_REFLOW are dropped:
+//     main no longer reads either (spec decoding always runs the V2 worker).
+//   - --served-model-name glm-5 is dropped so requests use the checkpoint name.
+
+export const config = {
+  modelName: "GLM-5.1",
+
+  // One A3 node is 8 cards x 2 dies = 16 devices; every recipe spans two nodes.
+  supportedHardware: ["a3"],
+
+  matchDims: [
+    {
+      id: "quant",
+      title: "Quantization",
+      options: [
+        { id: "w4a8", label: "W4A8", subtitle: "msModelSlim INT8" },
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      // `pdMode` is the id the engine keys its role-specific serving ports on
+      // (prefill 30000, decode 30100); the router command in the page uses them.
+      id: "pdMode",
+      title: "Deployment",
+      options: [
+        { id: "unified", label: "PD Mixed",       subtitle: "2 x A3 · 32 dies" },
+        { id: "prefill", label: "PD Disagg · Prefill", subtitle: "nodes 1-2 of 4" },
+        { id: "decode",  label: "PD Disagg · Decode",  subtitle: "nodes 3-4 of 4" },
+      ],
+    },
+  ],
+
+  modelNames: {
+    // ModelScope repo — pair with SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE=1 (set in every cell).
+    w4a8: "Eco-Tech/GLM-5.1-w4a8",
+  },
+
+  placeholders: {
+    HOST_IP:       { target: "command", label: "Bind host",                  default: "0.0.0.0"           },
+    PORT:          { target: "command", label: "Bind port",                  default: "30000"             },
+    NODE0_IP:      { target: "command", label: "Head node IP (of this role)", default: "<node0-ip>"         },
+    NODE_RANK:     { target: "command", label: "This node rank",             default: "<node-rank>"       },
+    NETWORK_IFACE: { target: "command", label: "Cross-node NIC",             default: "<your-nic>"        },
+    PREFILL_IP:    { target: "command", label: "Prefill head node IP",       default: "<prefill-node0-ip>" },
+    CURL_HOST:     { target: "curl",    label: "Server host",                default: "localhost"         },
+    CURL_PORT:     { target: "curl",    label: "Server or router port",      default: "30000"             },
+  },
+
+  curl: `curl http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1/chat/completions \\
+-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
+-d '{ "model": "{{MODEL_NAME}}", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"What is the capital of France?"}] }'`,
+
+  benchmarkCommands: {
+    speed:
+`python3 -m sglang.bench_serving \\
+  --backend sglang \\
+  --host {{CURL_HOST}} --port {{CURL_PORT}} \\
+  --dataset-name {{DATASET}} \\
+  --random-input-len {{ISL}} --random-output-len {{OSL}} \\
+  --random-range-ratio 1 \\
+  --num-prompts {{NUM_PROMPTS}} --max-concurrency {{MAX_CONCURRENCY}} \\
+  --seed 1 --flush-cache`,
+  },
+
+  // Pinned CANN 9.1.0 release image for Atlas 800I A3. v0.5.22 is the first
+  // release that carries both features these recipes need: NPU prefill CP
+  // (#39427) and --attn-dp-size (#41818). The rolling main-cann9.1.0-a3 tag
+  // works too but moves; re-pin here if a verification run uses another build.
+  dockerImages: {
+    a3: "quay.io/ascend/sglang:v0.5.22-cann9.1.0-a3",
+  },
+
+  // This page renders the deployment matrix only; the GPU Playground is not wired up here.
+  showPlaygroundLink: false,
+
+  github: {
+    cookbookModel: "zai-org/glm-5.1",
+  },
+
+  cells: [
+    // PD mixed: prefill and decode share one server across two A3 nodes (TP32).
+    {
+      match: { hw: "a3", quant: "w4a8", pdMode: "unified" },
+      nnodes: 2,
+      verified: false,
+      verificationStatus: "in-progress",
+      env: [
+        "SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE=1",
+        "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY=1",
+        "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32",
+        "SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1",
+        "SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=600",
+        "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME={{NETWORK_IFACE}}",
+        "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME={{NETWORK_IFACE}}",
+        "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2500",
+        "DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT=1",
+        "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=32",
+      ],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--device npu",
+        "--attention-backend ascend",
+        "--quantization modelslim",
+        "--tp-size 32",
+        "--attn-dp-size 16",
+        "--moe-a2a-backend deepep",
+        "--deepep-mode auto",
+        "--load-balance-method round_robin",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.65",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 65536",
+        "--max-prefill-tokens 280000",
+        "--max-running-requests 256",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 16",
+        "--speculative-algorithm NEXTN",
+        "--speculative-num-steps 3",
+        "--speculative-eagle-topk 1",
+        "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 4",
+        // The W4A8 checkpoint leaves the MTP (nextn) layer in BF16.
+        "--speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant",
+        "--reasoning-parser glm45",
+        "--tool-call-parser glm47",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    // PD disaggregation, prefill role: TP32 across the first two of four A3 nodes.
+    {
+      match: { hw: "a3", quant: "w4a8", pdMode: "prefill" },
+      nnodes: 2,
+      verified: false,
+      verificationStatus: "in-progress",
+      // The engine renders `warn` as plain text plus [label](#anchor) links only.
+      warn: "This is the prefill role of a 1P1D deployment on four A3 nodes: run it on two nodes, run PD Disagg · Decode on the other two, then front both roles with the router. All four nodes need the same ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL — see [Ascend NPU deployment](#ascend-npu-deployment).",
+      env: [
+        "SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE=1",
+        "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY=1",
+        "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32",
+        "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True",
+        // KV-transfer rendezvous: the same value on all four nodes.
+        "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL=tcp://{{PREFILL_IP}}:24670",
+        "SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=600",
+        "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME={{NETWORK_IFACE}}",
+        "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME={{NETWORK_IFACE}}",
+        "TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=2",
+        "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1200",
+        "DEEPEP_NORMAL_COMBINE_ENABLE_LONG_SEQ=1",
+        "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS=1024",
+        "DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND=16",
+        "DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT=1",
+      ],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--device npu",
+        "--attention-backend ascend",
+        "--quantization modelslim",
+        "--dtype bfloat16",
+        "--tp-size 32",
+        // The prefill role runs context parallelism across all 32 ranks, so it
+        // has no attention DP (interleave CP and DP attention are exclusive).
+        "--dp-size 1",
+        "--enable-prefill-cp",
+        "--cp-strategy interleave",
+        "--attn-cp-size 32",
+        "--moe-dense-tp-size 1",
+        "--moe-a2a-backend deepep",
+        "--deepep-mode normal",
+        "--disable-shared-experts-fusion",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-decode disabled",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled",
+        "--disaggregation-mode prefill",
+        "--disaggregation-transfer-backend ascend",
+        "--disaggregation-bootstrap-port 8998",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.75",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 524288",
+        "--max-prefill-tokens 180000",
+        "--max-running-requests 64",
+        "--load-balance-method round_robin",
+        "--reasoning-parser glm45",
+        "--tool-call-parser glm47",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    // PD disaggregation, decode role: TP32 / DP32 / EP32 across the other two nodes.
+    {
+      match: { hw: "a3", quant: "w4a8", pdMode: "decode" },
+      nnodes: 2,
+      verified: false,
+      verificationStatus: "in-progress",
+      warn: "This is the decode role of a 1P1D deployment on four A3 nodes: run it on the two nodes not used by PD Disagg · Prefill, start it after the prefill role, then front both roles with the router. All four nodes need the same ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL — see [Ascend NPU deployment](#ascend-npu-deployment).",
+      env: [
+        "SGLANG_USE_MODELSCOPE=1",
+        "SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY=1",
+        "STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32",
+        "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True",
+        "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL=tcp://{{PREFILL_IP}}:24670",
+        "SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=600",
+        "HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME={{NETWORK_IFACE}}",
+        "GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME={{NETWORK_IFACE}}",
+        "TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=0",
+        "DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=650",
+        "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=64",
+        "SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1",
+      ],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--device npu",
+        "--attention-backend ascend",
+        "--quantization modelslim",
+        "--dtype bfloat16",
+        "--tp-size 32",
+        "--attn-dp-size 32",
+        "--ep-size 32",
+        "--moe-a2a-backend deepep",
+        "--deepep-mode low_latency",
+        "--disable-shared-experts-fusion",
+        "--disaggregation-mode decode",
+        "--disaggregation-transfer-backend ascend",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.87",
+        "--max-running-requests 96",
+        "--cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 2 3",
+        "--context-length 180000",
+        "--tokenizer-worker-num 4",
+        "--load-balance-method round_robin",
+        "--watchdog-timeout 9000",
+        "--speculative-algorithm NEXTN",
+        "--speculative-num-steps 3",
+        "--speculative-eagle-topk 1",
+        "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 4",
+        "--speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant",
+        "--reasoning-parser glm45",
+        "--tool-call-parser glm47",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+  ],
+};
